外資也買進多檔傳產股，包括中鋼1.35萬張、台塑化1.17萬張、興富發5,310張、統一3,902張、寶成3,215張、和桐3,209張、德淵2,665張。ETF方面，外資買超較多的為復華富時不動產(00712)，買超4,256張。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks fell 529 points today (the 20th), testing the quarterly moving average again. Foreign investors continued net selling, offloading NT$79.54 billion, marking a 10‑day streak of net sales and a cumulative net outflow of NT$838.065 billion. However, they covered 1,450 contracts of Taiwan Index futures short positions, bringing the net short down to 89,700 contracts. In equities, foreign investors heavily sold ETFs and also net‑sold stocks such as AU Optronics and mature‑process wafer foundry groups, while on the flip side they bought several electronics contract manufacturers.

Foreign investors sold large amounts of ETFs today, including the actively managed CTBC Taiwan Yield ETF (00406A) – 130,700 units, the actively managed Uni-President Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A) – 29,100 units, and the actively managed Yuanta Core 50 ETF (00415A) – 14,100 units. They also net‑sold the Yuanta Taiwan 50 ETF (0050) – 49,000 units, the Qianyi Taiwan Select High‑Yield ETF (00919) – 15,900 units, and the KGI Taiwan TOP50 ETF (009816) – 15,500 units.

In individual stocks, foreign investors net‑sold AU Optronics for 31,600 units, as well as Powerchip Semiconductor (Powerchip) for 19,500 units, United Microelectronics (UMC) for 18,600 units, and Formosa Plastics for 12,500 units. In the financial sector they net‑sold Taishin Financial (Taishin) and Shin Kong Financial for 22,500 units and 11,300 units respectively.

Foreign investors’ net purchases focused on electronics contract manufacturers, including Wistron for 32,800 units, Compal for 15,000 units, Inventec for 8,068 units, Pegatron for 7,718 units, Foxconn for 3,854 units, and Quanta for 3,171 units. They also bought Taiwan Glass (TGC) for 17,700 units, Acer for 10,800 units, MSI for 5,391 units, GIS‑KY for 3,195 units, Hoshin (Ho‑Shin) for 2,881 units, and Taiwan Mobile for 2,712 units.

Foreign investors also bought several traditional‑industry stocks, including China Steel for 13,500 units, Formosa Plastics Corp. (Formosa Plastics) for 11,700 units, Xing Fu Development for 5,310 units, Uni-President for 3,902 units, Pou Chen for 3,215 units, HET (He Tong) for 3,209 units, and Deyuan for 2,665 units. Among ETFs, the most heavily bought was the Fuhua FTSE Real Estate ETF (00712), with a net purchase of 4,256 units.

items.title: 晶片股高點還在後頭？分析師看好漲勢延續至2027年
items.title_en: Chip Stocks Still Have Higher Peaks Ahead? Analysts See Upside Continuing Through 2027
paras: 《Investing.com》報導，Truist週二(20日)在一份報告中指出，半導體產業的基本面與股價報酬高峰都還在前方。歷史數據顯示，晶片股通常會在基本面見頂後約一季才觸及高點。
分析師William Stein寫道，「半導體基本面正處於超級週期（SuperCycle），成長速度更快、持續時間也更長，甚至超越1998年至2001年的科技泡沫時期。」
市場共識預估，2026年第四季半導體營收將年增74%。Stein指出，該季將是營收連續第15季改善，也可能成為這波週期的高峰。
他補充，相較之下，半導體需求通常在第7季、成長率達29%時見頂。科技泡沫時期的成長率高峰則為50%，而該輪週期在第14季時就已經崩跌。
Stein認為，這波週期強勁的主要原因是資料中心與AI需求。他也指出，由於不同產業的復甦時程並不同步，工業需求較晚才回升，進一步延長了這波週期的持續時間。
與一般認為股市會領先基本面約兩季的看法相反，Truist的研究發現，半導體股平均會在營收成長見頂後一季才觸及高點。
Stein表示，「這意味著半導體股至少到2027年第一季都應能持續帶來正報酬，至於行情能延續多久，則取決於未來幾季基本面成長是否進一步加速。若出現這種情況，我們並不意外。」
這位分析師也提到，費城半導體指數曾在6月22日至7月29日期間回檔29%。他指出，如此幅度的跌勢若未進一步演變成下行週期，歷史上相當罕見。
Stein寫道，「對我們而言，這意味著只要基本面維持穩健，股價進一步下跌的空間就有限。我們認為，即將公布的財報很可能成為多數我們追蹤公司的股價穩定催化劑。」
Truist重申對受惠於AI需求的輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)、超微(AMD-US)、博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)、Monolithic Power Systems(MPWR-US)及TTM Technologies(TTMI-US)給予「買進」評級。
此外，Truist也看好商業模式被形容為較脆弱、但仍獲「買進」評級的公司，包括Vishay、Arrow Electronics、Avnet、Diodes及Sensata。
paras_en: Investing.com reported that Truist on Tuesday (the 20th) said in a note that both the fundamentals of the semiconductor industry and the peak of stock returns are still ahead. Historical data shows chip stocks typically hit their highs about a quarter after fundamentals top out.
Analyst William Stein wrote, “Semiconductor fundamentals are in a super‑cycle, growing faster and lasting longer, even surpassing the tech bubble period of 1998‑2001.”

The market consensus forecasts semiconductor revenue to grow 74% year‑over‑year in Q4 2026. Stein noted that quarter would mark the 15th consecutive quarter of revenue improvement and could be the peak of this cycle.

He added that, by comparison, semiconductor demand usually peaks in the 7th quarter of a cycle at a 29% growth rate. The tech‑bubble era’s growth‑rate peak was 50%, and that cycle collapsed already in its 14th quarter.

Stein believes the strength of this cycle is driven mainly by data‑center and AI demand. He also pointed out that because recovery timelines differ across industries, industrial demand rebounds later, further extending the duration of this cycle.

Contrary to the common view that the stock market leads fundamentals by about two quarters, Truist’s research finds semiconductor stocks on average reach their price peaks one quarter after revenue growth tops out.

Stein said, “This means semiconductor stocks should continue delivering positive returns at least through Q1 2027; how long the rally lasts will depend on whether fundamental growth accelerates in the coming quarters. If that happens, we wouldn’t be surprised.”
The analyst also noted that the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 29% between June 22 and July 29. He said such a decline, if it does not turn into a down‑cycle, is historically rare.

Stein wrote, “For us, this means that as long as fundamentals stay solid, there is limited room for further price declines. We think the upcoming earnings reports are likely to act as a catalyst for price stability in most of the companies we follow.”
Truist reaffirmed “Buy” ratings on AI‑benefiting companies Nvidia (NVDA‑US), AMD (AMD‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US), Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR‑US) and TTM Technologies (TTMI‑US).
In addition, Truist is bullish on companies described as having more fragile business models but still receiving “Buy” ratings, including Vishay, Arrow Electronics, Avnet, Diodes and Sensata.

items.title: 〈財報〉AI業務成最大金雞母！SpaceX營收暴增161% 馬斯克證實討論與特斯拉合併
paras: 拜人工智慧(AI)業務大幅成長之賜，全球首富馬斯克的SpaceX(SPCX-US)第3季營收狂飆161%，與獲利一同交出優於市場預期的表現，最新發布的2027年度第1季財測也輕鬆超越市場預期，周二(20日)盤後應聲上漲近5%。
馬斯克在財報電話會議上表示，已成立特殊委員會開始討論SpaceX與特斯拉(TSLA-US)合併事宜，合併「將是個好主意」。特斯拉周二盤後應聲攀高1%，該公司緊接著將在周三盤後公布財報。

2027Q1財測關鍵數字 vs 分析師預估


營收：330-370億美元 vs 222億美元


Q3(9月為止)財報關鍵數字 vs 分析師預估


營收：145.8億美元 vs 127.2億美元
淨利：44億美元，去年同期淨損10.5億美元 vs 18.8億美元
營業利益：28億美元
調整後EPS：45美分 vs 13美分


馬斯克(Elon Musk)旗下涵蓋衛星、火箭與AI業務的SpaceX在財報新聞稿中表示，第3季營業利益為28億美元，淨利達44億美元，而去年同期則是淨虧損10.5億美元。
SpaceX財務長Bret Johnsen在財報電話會議上預估，明年第1季營收將達330億至370億美元，他把亮麗展望歸功於「對未來六個月運算服務合約的商機掌握度提高」。
馬斯克在與投資人舉行的電話會議上表示：「SpaceX在火箭發射、連網服務與超級智慧(SI)這三大領域，正處於一個轉折時刻。」
SpaceX周二盤後上漲4.7%。該公司股價自6月以每股135美元完成創紀錄的首次公開發行(IPO)以來就陷入波動劇烈，周二正規交易時段收在每股147.79美元，目前市值2兆美元。

AI業務轉虧為盈 第3季營收年增逾八倍

SpaceX的AI業務目前更名為「超級智慧」(Super Intelligence，SI)，第3季營收從去年同期的8.13億美元躍升至75.6億美元，是去年同期的九倍以上，主要來自出租運算能力。
不過，AI業務也占公司196億美元資本支出中的164億美元，SpaceX預期近期資本支出將維持在接近這一水準。
SpaceX目前的AI收入主要來自向Anthropic、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google及Reflection AI等業者出租資料中心運算能力。該公司還在8月收購開發熱門AI程式碼工具的Cursor，而xAI開發的大型語言模型Grok採用率有所提升。

星鏈連網業務持續擴張 訂戶增至1,360萬人

SpaceX以可重複使用火箭聞名，但最近幾季公司的大部分營收與獲利主要來自連網業務部門，包括星鏈(Starlink)衛星網路服務。
星鏈第3季訂戶數增至1,360萬戶，高於前一季的1,200萬戶，高於分析師所估的1,219萬戶。
儘管用戶數不如預期，SpaceX的連網業務表現仍超越市場所料，第3季營收為52.5億美元，年增69%。其中，消費者Starlink訂戶占31.2億美元營收，政府及企業客戶則占21.3億美元。
由於SpaceX本月稍早宣布收購低頻頻譜，加上美國聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)批准該公司部署由1.5萬顆衛星組成的衛星星系計畫，市場對Starlink建立美國行動通訊網路的關注持續升溫。

星艦火箭發射業務成長有限 獲利仍靠星鏈撐

相較之下，SpaceX的太空發射業務僅小幅成長，第3季營收從去年同期的16.7億美元增至17.7億美元。
目前SpaceX幾乎所有獲利仍來自星鏈。連網業務部門營業利益幾乎翻倍至23.7億美元，AI業務則轉虧為盈，營業利益為4.31億美元。太空部門則出現700萬美元營業虧損。
SpaceX下一代可重複使用火箭系統「星艦」(Starship)尚未投入商業營運。這套系統預期將協助部署傳輸頻寬更高的星鏈衛星，以及軌道AI運算基礎設施。能否將星艦發展為可靠且可重複使用的運載工具，是SpaceX長期策略的關鍵。

items.title: 經濟學家警告：AI泡沫可能從投資人未關注的地方破裂
items.title_en: Economists Warn: AI Bubble Could Burst From Overlooked Areas
paras: AI泡沫疑慮升溫之際，一名經濟學家警告，投資人可能忽略了這波熱潮中的其他弱點。
Global Data.TS Lombard全球總體經濟董事總經理波金斯(Dario Perkins)在19日的報告中寫道：「引爆點不一定來自這波熱潮內部，也可能來自外部。」
他強調，目前 AI 產業的大部分營收成長，依然停留在生態系內部的資金循環，而非源自企業與消費者對 AI 服務的實質買單；關鍵在於這些收入究竟是來自產業外部，為了提升生產力而支付的費用，抑或僅是資本支出在體系內的重複轉手。
這項警告發布之際，恰逢近期晶片股遭到拋售，加深了市場對巨額 AI 基礎建設投資能否回收的擔憂。費城半導體指數繼先前重挫逾 11% 後，僅微幅回升 2%。
科技巨頭之外的債務隱憂
波金斯特別點出 AI 產業鏈中的脆弱環節，首先是科技巨頭之外的債務風險。
微軟、亞馬遜與Google等超大規模雲端業者的資產負債表雖然穩健，規模較小的雲端服務商、模型開發商與基礎建設供應商，卻持續提高財務槓桿。
波金斯估計，AI生態系部分領域的債務規模，到2027年底可能達到2兆美元。
他不認為AI相關債務構成系統性金融風險，但警告，獲利不如預期與訂單取消，可能在整個生態系引發連鎖效應。即使是現金充裕的超大規模雲端業者，也可能決定不再續租資料中心，讓財務較脆弱的公司承受風險。
晶片供過於求、利率走高恐衝擊投資
另一個潛在威脅則是晶片出現意料之外的過剩。由於企業先前為防止短缺而過度下單，一旦需求放緩，極可能造成供過於求。半導體與科技硬體屬高度週期性產業，極易受到「長鞭效應」影響。
此外，高利率環境也將進一步削弱 AI 投資的經濟效益，對仰賴舉債擴展業務的公司影響尤甚。
民意反彈也可能成為引爆點
除了企業獲利之外，波金斯認為另一個重大威脅來自政治層面的反彈。
他直言社交媒體上的 AI 擁護者猶如活在同溫層中，忽略了普通大眾對 AI 的反感。「他們沒有意識到，一般人並不喜歡AI。他們不覺得AI有用，更非常不願意住在資料中心附近，也擔心自己的工作。而且，他們會投票。」
他強調，只要發生一起引人關注的重大意外，就可能在短時間內讓 AI 形象徹底黑化，觸發大規模的社會與政治反彈。
paras_en: As concerns about an AI bubble heat up, an economist warns that investors may be overlooking other weak spots in this frenzy.

Dario Perkins, Managing Director of Global Data.TS Lombard’s Global Macro team, wrote in his report on the 19th: “The trigger point may not come from within the hype itself, but could arise from outside it.”

He stresses that most of the current AI industry’s revenue growth remains confined to internal capital circulation within the ecosystem, rather than stemming from genuine purchases of AI services by businesses and consumers; the key question is whether this income comes from outside the industry as a productivity‑enhancing expense, or merely represents repeated capital spending within the system.

The warning comes as chip stocks have recently been sold off, deepening market worries about whether massive AI infrastructure investments can be recouped. After the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell more than 11% earlier, it has only barely rebounded by 2%.
Debt risks beyond the tech giants
Perkins points out a fragile link in the AI supply chain: debt risk outside the major tech giants.

While the balance sheets of ultra‑large cloud providers such as Microsoft, Amazon and Google are solid, smaller cloud service firms, model developers and infrastructure suppliers are continuously increasing financial leverage.
Perkins estimates that debt in certain parts of the AI ecosystem could reach $2 trillion by the end of 2027.

He does not see AI‑related debt as a systemic financial risk, but warns that weaker‑than‑expected profits and order cancellations could trigger a chain reaction across the ecosystem. Even cash‑rich mega‑cloud providers might decide not to renew data‑center leases, leaving financially vulnerable companies exposed.
Chip oversupply and rising rates could hit investment

Another potential threat is an unexpected surplus of chips. Companies previously over‑ordered to avoid shortages; if demand eases, a supply glut could emerge. Semiconductors and tech hardware are highly cyclical industries, easily affected by a “bullwhip effect.”
Moreover, a high‑interest‑rate environment will further erode the economic returns of AI investments, hitting firms that rely on borrowing to expand especially hard.
Public backlash could also be a spark
Beyond corporate profits, Perkins sees a major threat from political backlash.

He bluntly says AI supporters on social media live in an echo chamber, ignoring ordinary people’s aversion to AI. “They don’t realize that most people don’t like AI. They don’t find it useful, they strongly dislike living near data centers, they fear for their jobs, and they will vote.”
He stresses that a single high‑profile incident could quickly tarnish AI’s image, triggering a massive social and political backlash.

items.title: 延宕多年終獲准！波音737 Max 10通過FAA認證 未來數月啟動交付
items.title_en: Delayed for Years, Finally Approved! Boeing 737 Max 10 Gains FAA Certification, Deliveries to Begin in Coming Months
paras: 多家外媒報導，波音 (BA-US) 旗下 737 Max 系列最大機型 737 Max 10，週二 (20 日) 正式取得美國聯邦航空總署 (FAA) 認證，為延宕多年的交機計畫掃除關鍵障礙。波音表示，預計未來數月開始交付，目前已取得來自 30 家客戶、共 1,555 架訂單。
737 Max 10 最多可搭載 230 名乘客，也是 737 Max 家族最後取得 FAA 認證的機型。波音指出，該機型約占整體 Max 未交付訂單的 30%，客戶包括阿拉斯加航空 (ALK-US)、美國航空 (AAL-US)、聯合航空 (UAL-US) 與達美航空 (DAL-US)。
取得認證後，波音得以推進交機作業，但航空公司仍需完成相關營運準備，將新機納入正式航班時刻表可能還要數月。
波音商用飛機部門執行長 Stephanie Pope 表示，完成認證計畫，為公司交付這款飛機鋪平道路。
737 Max 10 原定於 2020 年投入營運，但 2018 年及 2019 年接連發生的兩起 Max 空難，使監管機關加強審查，加上其他安全問題與工程設計變更，導致認證進度一再延後。其中，波音也必須調整發動機防結冰系統。
認證程序本月稍早又因一項可能影響降落程序的軟體問題而延宕。
不過，聯邦官員審查後認定，這項導航系統異常不構成飛航安全問題，最終批准認證。
多年延宕，也讓部分航空公司原先的客艙規畫面臨調整。
聯合航空執行長 Scott Kirby 今年 8 月曾表示，公司多年前為 Max 10 訂購的平躺座椅仍放在倉庫，如今已不再符合需求。阿拉斯加航空則於上月宣布，計畫在部分 737 Max 10 配置平躺座椅，擴大高階客艙服務。
隨著 Max 10 終於獲准，美國飛機認證流程的效率也成為焦點。美國運輸部長Sean Duffy 接受訪問時表示，安全仍是首要考量，但美國需要改善認證流程，以維持航空產業競爭力。
Duffy指出，波音飛機在歐洲完成認證所需的時間，約為美國的一半，甚至不到一半。
他還提及中國正積極爭取航空產業主導地位，強調美國若要保持競爭力，就必須加快飛機認證速度。
這次核准也為波音推進營運復甦增添助力。FAA 已於今年 8 月初批准 Max 系列最小機型 Max 7，波音則持續提高 737 Max 與 787 夢幻客機產量，並於 7 月在華盛頓州艾弗雷特啟用第 4 條 737 Max 生產線。
由於航空公司及其他客戶通常在交機時支付大部分購機款，提高產量並完成交付，是波音改善現金流的關鍵。
儘管認證取得重大進展，波音 (BA-US) 週二盤後股價微升 0.34%。分析指出，市場先前已普遍預期 Max 10 將獲批准，可能是股價反應有限的原因。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media reported that Boeing's (BA-US) largest 737 Max variant, the 737 Max 10, officially received certification from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on Tuesday (the 20th), clearing a key hurdle for a delivery program that has been delayed for years. Boeing said deliveries are expected to start in the next few months and it already has orders for 1,555 aircraft from 30 customers.

The 737 Max 10 can seat up to 230 passengers and is the last model in the Max family to obtain FAA certification. Boeing noted that the type represents about 30% of the total undelivered Max order backlog, with customers including Alaska Airlines (ALK-US), American Airlines (AAL-US), United Airlines (UAL-US) and Delta Air Lines (DAL-US).

With certification secured, Boeing can move forward with deliveries, but airlines still need to complete operational preparations, and it may take several months before the new jets are placed into regular flight schedules.
Boeing Commercial Airplanes CEO Stephanie Pope said that completing the certification program paves the way for the company to deliver the aircraft.

The Max 10 was originally slated to enter service in 2020, but two fatal Max crashes in 2018 and 2019 prompted regulators to tighten scrutiny. Additional safety issues and engineering design changes, including adjustments to the engine anti‑icing system, repeatedly pushed back the certification timeline.
The certification process was further delayed earlier this month by a software issue that could affect the landing procedure.
However, after review, federal officials determined the navigation‑system anomaly did not constitute a flight‑safety issue and ultimately approved the certification.
The years‑long delay has forced some airlines to revise their original cabin‑layout plans.

United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby said in August that the lie‑flat seats United ordered for the Max 10 years ago are still in storage and no longer meet the airline’s needs. Alaska Airlines announced last month that it plans to equip some Max 10s with lie‑flat seats to expand premium cabin service.

With the Max 10 finally cleared, the efficiency of the U.S. aircraft certification process has come under scrutiny. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said safety remains the top priority, but the United States needs to improve the certification process to keep the aviation industry competitive.
Duffy noted that the time required for Boeing aircraft to receive certification in Europe is roughly half, or even less than half, of the time needed in the United States.
He also mentioned that China is actively seeking a leading role in the aviation sector and stressed that the U.S. must speed up aircraft certification if it wants to stay competitive.

The approval also adds momentum to Boeing’s effort to revive operations. The FAA approved the smallest Max variant, the Max 7, in early August, Boeing continues to ramp up production of the 737 Max and 787 Dreamliner, and opened a fourth 737 Max production line in Everett, Washington, in July.
Because airlines and other customers typically pay most of the purchase price at delivery, increasing production and completing deliveries is key for Boeing to improve its cash flow.

Despite the significant certification milestone, Boeing’s (BA-US) after‑hours stock price rose only 0.34% on Tuesday. Analysts said the market had already largely expected Max 10 approval, which may explain the modest price reaction.

items.title: 傳陸企下訂逾350億美元晶片大單 輝達股價仍難振作
items.title_en: Chinese firms place over $35 billion chip order, Nvidia stock still struggles
paras: 即使傳出中國科技巨頭向輝達 (NVDA-US) 下單逾350億美元，輝達股價仍未明顯走高。龐大需求雖凸顯中國業者對其產品的依賴，但產能不足讓訂單能否轉化為營收存在變數，市場對人工智慧 (AI) 支出與融資負擔的疑慮也尚未消退。
輝達週二 (20日) 收低0.29%，報每股216.47美元，雖已收斂稍早約2%的跌幅，表現仍落後同業。同一時間，英特爾 (INTC-US) 與超微 (AMD-US) 分別下滑約0.37%及0.62%，費城半導體指數收黑約0.3%。
輝達晶片採購消息來自《路透》報導。知情人士透露，阿里巴巴 (BABA-US)、騰訊 (00700-HK) 與字節跳動，合計訂購超過300萬張輝達 RTX PRO 5500 顯卡，按每張約11,400美元的標價計算，潛在總值超過350億美元。
RTX PRO 5500 是專業工作站顯卡，效能不及輝達更先進的資料中心處理器。
不過，在美國出口管制限制中國取得高階晶片的情況下，這款產品成為替代選項，中國業者主要希望將其用於 AI 推論，也就是執行已完成訓練的模型。
然而，客戶下單不代表輝達能全數交貨。
《路透》消息人士指出，輝達已告知客戶與合作夥伴，由於需求遠超過原定生產規模，無法保證滿足全部訂單，部分合作夥伴可能只能取得原訂購量的5%至10%。
消息人士另稱，中國客戶對 RTX PRO 5500 的總訂購量已超過600萬張，但輝達2027年全球產量可能不超過300萬張。
上述數字屬於消息人士透露的訂單估計與生產規畫，並非公司正式公布的指引。
產能分配也限制輝達擴大供貨的空間。
隨著下一代 Rubin 平台成為製造重點，輝達須在不同產品之間配置資源，進一步增加 RTX PRO 5500 訂單的交付變數。
《Stocks Down Under》因此分析，需求與供應之間的落差，有助於解釋市場為何未對這筆大單更為振奮。
此外，這項消息傳出之際，AI 類股正承受投資情緒轉弱的壓力。
市場擔憂，建置 AI 基礎設施所需的龐大資本支出與舉債，能否換得足以支撐估值的投資回報，讓單一訂單利多難以扭轉整體疑慮。
截至週一，輝達過去2週累計下跌逾10%。即使週一反彈1.4%，股價仍低於50日移動平均線。對投資人而言，後續關鍵在於實際交貨規模，以及這些訂單能為輝達帶來多少營收與獲利。
paras_en: Even though reports say a Chinese tech giant placed an order of more than $35 billion with Nvidia (NVDA-US), the stock has not risen noticeably. The huge demand underscores Chinese firms' reliance on its products, but capacity constraints make it uncertain whether the orders will translate into revenue, and concerns about AI spending and financing burdens remain unresolved.

Nvidia closed Tuesday (the 20th) down 0.29% at $216.47 per share, having narrowed an earlier roughly 2% drop, but its performance still lagged peers. At the same time, Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US) fell about 0.37% and 0.62% respectively, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was down about 0.3%.

The news of Nvidia chip purchases came from a Reuters report. Sources said Alibaba (BABA-US), Tencent (00700-HK) and ByteDance together ordered more than 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards, priced at roughly $11,400 each, giving a potential total value of over $35 billion.
The RTX PRO 5500 is a professional workstation graphics card whose performance is below Nvidia's more advanced data‑center processors.

However, under U.S. export controls that limit China's access to high‑end chips, this product becomes a substitute option, with Chinese firms mainly hoping to use it for AI inference – running models that have already been trained.
Nevertheless, a customer order does not guarantee Nvidia can deliver the full quantity.

Reuters sources said Nvidia has told customers and partners that, because demand far exceeds its planned production capacity, it cannot guarantee fulfillment of all orders and some partners may only receive 5% to 10% of the originally requested amount.
The sources added that Chinese customers' total order for the RTX PRO 5500 has exceeded 6 million units, while Nvidia’s global output for 2027 may not exceed 3 million units.
These figures are estimates of orders and production plans disclosed by sources, not formal guidance from the company.
Capacity allocation also limits Nvidia’s ability to expand supply.
As the next‑generation Rubin platform becomes a manufacturing focus, Nvidia must allocate resources across different products, further increasing the uncertainty of delivering RTX PRO 5500 orders.
Stocks Down Under therefore analyses that the gap between demand and supply helps explain why the market has not reacted more positively to the large order.
Moreover, the news comes as AI‑related stocks are under pressure from weakening investor sentiment.

The market worries that the massive capital expenditures and debt required to build AI infrastructure may not generate sufficient returns to justify valuations, making a single order’s upside insufficient to offset broader concerns.

As of Monday, Nvidia had fallen more than 10% over the past two weeks. Even after a 1.4% rebound on Monday, the share price remained below its 50‑day moving average. For investors, the next key issues are the actual delivery scale and how much revenue and profit these orders will generate for Nvidia.

items.title: 〈財報〉Netflix Q3優預期盤後仍跌6% 廣告與營收展望拖累
items.title_en: <Earnings> Netflix Q3 Beats Expectations but Shares Fall 6% After Hours; Ad and Revenue Outlook Dragging
paras: 串流影音巨頭Netflix(NFLX-US)週二(20日)盤後公布第三季(截至9/30)財報，獲利優於分析師預期，營收則符合預估，但下修了全年廣告業務營收預測，也收窄2026全年財測區間，導致盤後股價下跌6%。
Netflix表示，受惠於會員數成長，以及3月生效的訂閱價格調漲，公司營收年增近12%。Netflix指出，消費者對此次漲價的反應，與過去調價的情況及公司預期一致。
第三季淨利為36.6億美元，或每股盈餘0.87美元；去年同期淨利為25.5億美元，或每股盈餘0.59美元。Netflix表示，獲利年增部分歸因於費用認列的時間差異。

Q3 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：128.7 億美元 v.s. 128.7 億美元
調整後EPS：0.87 美元 v.s. 0.82 美元


公司預期，第四季營收將年增逾11%，達134.4億美元，成長動能來自會員數增加、訂閱價格調整及廣告收入成長。
Netflix收窄2026年全年財測區間，目前預期全年營收將達511億美元，較前一年成長13%。這個數字落在公司前次財報所提供的510億至514億美元預測區間低端，也低於LSEG預估的全年營收512億美元。
華爾街與投資人密切關注Netflix在近期組織調整後，是否會進一步說明公司策略。Netflix目前面臨的挑戰包括觀看時數成長停滯，以及YouTube等競爭對手帶來的競爭壓力。
Netflix週二在致股東信中表示，「在競爭激烈、爭奪消費者注意力的內容大量湧現之際，清晰的策略方向與卓越的執行力至關重要。第三季，我們在三項優先工作上都取得良好成果，但我們認為，透過持續聚焦與不斷改善，仍有進一步提升的空間。」
Netflix上週宣布裁員約6%，相當於約1,000名員工。同時，內容長Bela Bajaria也將離開現任職位。
Netflix週二表示，預期第四季業績將受到裁員影響，營業利益率將因此減少約120個基點。
前迪士尼高層Peter Rice已獲任命為新任內容長，但他將如何處理觀看時數成長方面的疑慮，目前仍不明朗。
Netflix在致股東信中表示，「我們知道部分投資人對觀看時數的成長感到擔憂。」但公司強調，「涵蓋觀看數量、品質與多樣性的用戶參與度仍維持健康，且我們持續為會員提供強大的價值。」
公司希望加快觀看時數的成長，並計劃透過三大策略達成目標：為會員提供更多娛樂價值、運用科技改善服務的各個面向，以及提升營收變現能力。
Netflix提供的價值中，價格較低的廣告方案一直是重要的一環。然而，公司週二下修了全年廣告業務營收預測。
Netflix目前預期，2026年廣告營收約為27億美元，低於先前預估的約30億美元。公司表示，這次下修是因為部分廣告產品功能的推出進度慢於預期。
週二稍早，Netflix宣布推出多項廣告業者新功能，表示這些功能將協助品牌更精準地接觸目標受眾，並衡量廣告投放成效。
paras_en: Streaming giant Netflix (NFLX-US) posted its third‑quarter (ended Sep 30) results after market close on Tuesday the 20th. Profit topped analysts’ forecasts and revenue met estimates, but the company cut its full‑year ad‑business revenue outlook and narrowed its 2026 full‑year financial guidance range, sending the stock down 6% after hours.

Netflix said that growth in subscriber numbers and a subscription price increase that took effect in March helped revenue rise nearly 12% year over year. The company noted that consumer reaction to the price hike was in line with past adjustments and its own expectations.

Third‑quarter net income was $3.66 billion, or earnings per share of $0.87; a year earlier net income was $2.55 billion, or $0.59 per share. Netflix attributed the year‑over‑year profit increase in part to timing differences in expense recognition.

Q3 key figures versus LSEG estimates: Revenue $12.87 billion vs. $12.87 billion; Adjusted EPS $0.87 vs. $0.82. The company projects fourth‑quarter revenue to grow more than 11% year over year to $13.44 billion, driven by higher subscriber counts, subscription price adjustments and ad‑revenue growth.

Netflix narrowed its 2026 full‑year financial guidance, now expecting total revenue of $51.1 billion, up 13% from the prior year. This figure sits at the low end of the company’s previous $51.0‑$51.4 billion range and below LSEG’s $51.2 billion revenue estimate.

Wall Street and investors are watching closely to see whether Netflix will further clarify its strategy after recent organizational changes. Challenges facing the company include stalled growth in viewing hours and competitive pressure from rivals such as YouTube.

In a letter to shareholders on Tuesday, Netflix said, “In an environment of intense competition and a flood of content vying for consumer attention, clear strategic direction and excellent execution are critical. In Q3 we delivered solid results on all three priority areas, but we believe there is still room for improvement through continued focus and relentless refinement.”
Netflix announced last week a roughly 6% workforce reduction, about 1,000 jobs, and content chief Bela Bajaria will be departing her current role.
The company said on Tuesday that fourth‑quarter performance would be affected by the layoffs, with operating margin expected to shrink by roughly 120 basis points.
Former Disney executive Peter Rice has been appointed as the new head of content, but how he will address concerns about viewing‑hour growth remains unclear.

In its shareholder letter, Netflix acknowledged, “We know some investors are concerned about the growth of viewing hours.” The company emphasized that overall user engagement—covering volume, quality and variety of viewing—remains healthy and that it continues to deliver strong value to members.

Netflix aims to accelerate viewing‑hour growth and plans to do so through three main strategies: delivering more entertainment value to members, leveraging technology to improve all aspects of the service, and enhancing revenue‑monetization capabilities.
Ad‑supported, lower‑priced subscription tiers have long been a key part of Netflix’s value proposition. However, the company cut its full‑year ad‑business revenue forecast on Tuesday.
Netflix now expects 2026 ad revenue to be about $2.7 billion, down from the prior estimate of roughly $3.0 billion, citing slower‑than‑expected rollout of certain ad‑product features.
Earlier on Tuesday, Netflix announced a suite of new ad‑seller features, saying they will help brands reach target audiences more precisely and measure the effectiveness of their ad spend.

items.title: 馬斯克證實！SpaceX、特斯拉成立特別委員會 評估「合併」可能性
items.title_en: Musk Confirms! SpaceX and Tesla Form Special Committees to Assess Merger Possibility
paras: 馬斯克週二 (20 日) 證實，SpaceX 與特斯拉已各自成立由獨立董事組成的特別委員會，評估潛在合併案。他表態支持，認為合併「會是個好主意」，但強調交易能否成真仍有變數。
同時擔任兩家公司執行長的馬斯克，在 SpaceX 財報電話會議上表示，由於自身存在利益衝突，無法直接參與雙方的合併討論。
SpaceX 與特斯拉近來持續加深晶片及人工智慧 (AI) 專案合作，加上兩家公司均由馬斯克掌舵，市場數月來不斷揣測雙方可能合併，部分分析師與投資人甚至認為，交易遲早會發生。
馬斯克指出，雙方若進一步在 AI、晶片、機器人及連網技術等領域攜手合作，「有很多可以獲益的地方」，顯示他看好兩家公司整合技術與資源的潛在效益。
不過，他也淡化合併勢在必行的說法，表示若認定交易一定會完成，「就說得太過了」。他指出，交易仍須取得特斯拉股東支持，並形容相關表決門檻很高。
消息受到投資人關注。SpaceX (SPCX-US) 股價在盤後交易跳漲約 5%，特斯拉(TSLA-US) 則上漲約 1.1%，並在馬斯克發表合併相關評論後，漲勢略有增強。
巴克萊分析師 Dan Levy 上週三 (14 日) 發布報告指出，隨著兩家公司業務日益重疊，投資人對雙方合併的預期正在升高。若要將合併提案納入特斯拉今年股東會表決，宣布交易的時間窗口已逐漸縮小；即使錯過，雙方仍可能在未來 6 至 12 個月內提出交易。
至於可能的交易方式，巴克萊認為，較可能的架構是由 SpaceX 擔任收購方，以股票支付對價。報告估計，未計收購溢價前，每股特斯拉股票約可換取 0.7 股 SpaceX 股票，實際換股條件仍取決於最終交易安排。
依巴克萊設定的交易情境，馬斯克可能持有合併後公司約 37% 股權；在報告假設的股權與表決權安排下，其表決權可能達約 56%，掌握過半投票權。不過，上述交易架構與數字均屬分析師推估，並非雙方已公布的交易條件。
paras_en: Musk confirmed on Tuesday (the 20th) that SpaceX and Tesla have each set up a special committee composed of independent directors to evaluate a potential merger. He expressed support, saying a merger "would be a good idea," but stressed that there are still variables that could affect whether the deal materializes.
As the CEO of both companies, Musk said during SpaceX's earnings call that, due to a conflict of interest, he cannot take part directly in the merger discussions between the two firms.

SpaceX and Tesla have recently deepened cooperation on chip and artificial‑intelligence (AI) projects, and with Musk at the helm of both, the market has been speculating for months about a possible merger, with some analysts and investors even believing the deal is inevitable.

Musk noted that if the two companies further collaborate in AI, chips, robotics and connectivity technologies, "there are many areas where they could benefit," indicating his optimism about the potential synergies of integrating their technologies and resources.

However, he downplayed the notion that a merger is a foregone conclusion, saying that claiming the deal is certain "would be overstating it." He added that the transaction still needs approval from Tesla shareholders and described the voting threshold as very high.

The news attracted investor attention. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) shares jumped about 5% in after‑hours trading, while Tesla (TSLA‑US) rose roughly 1.1%, with the upward momentum slightly strengthening after Musk’s merger comments.

Barclays analyst Dan Levy released a report last Wednesday (the 14th) noting that as the two companies’ businesses increasingly overlap, investor expectations for a merger are rising. If a merger proposal were to be put to Tesla’s shareholders this year, the window for announcing a deal is narrowing; even if missed, a transaction could still be proposed within the next 6 to 12 months.

Regarding a possible deal structure, Barclays sees the most likely scenario as SpaceX acting as the acquirer and paying with stock. The report estimates that, before any acquisition premium, each Tesla share could be exchanged for about 0.7 SpaceX shares, though the actual swap terms would depend on the final agreement.

Under Barclays’ assumed transaction scenario, Musk could own roughly 37% of the combined company; with the assumed equity and voting‑rights arrangement, his voting power could reach about 56%, giving him majority control. These figures are analyst estimates and not disclosed terms from either party.

items.title: Meta Muse拿下兩場勝利 其中一場擊敗ChatGPT
items.title_en: Meta's Muse Scores Two Wins, One of Which Beats ChatGPT
paras: Meta(META-US) 新款 AI 代理 Muse 的熱潮是否正在降溫？至少從華爾街緊盯的下載數據來看，完全看不出這種跡象。
根據 Sensor Tower 最新公布的數據，Muse 自 9 月 8 日推出以來，累計下載量已達 1,090 萬次，其中美國下載量超過 1,020 萬次。
相較之下，OpenAI 旗下 ChatGPT 過去 30 天在美國的下載量，較前一個 30 天減少 25%。
Sensor Tower 估計，Muse 的日活躍用戶數於 10 月 16 日首度達到 250 萬人，最近七天較前一週成長 15%。
Sensor Tower 表示，此前僅有另外 11 款 App 能在 40 天內於美國累積 1,000 萬次下載，最近一次達成此紀錄的是 Meta 於 2023 年 7 月推出的 Threads。
這股成長動能可望讓華爾街樂見其成。自 Muse 推出以來，華爾街便對其成長前景提出積極預測。
德意志銀行分析師班傑明·布萊克（Benjamin Black）預期，到 2030 年，Muse 將貢獻 Meta 高達 8% 的營收，約合 360 億美元；即便是較保守的估計，Muse 到 2030 年也能進帳 24 億美元。
布萊克表示，Meta 在當前 AI 代理服務中找到了明確的市場空白，該產品結合行動 App 生態系與極致順暢的消費端用戶介面，具備自主完成交易的能力、絕大部分功能免費，且在獨立虛擬機器中保持全天候運行，這些特色使其在當前市場中幾乎獨一無二。
Meta預定於周三(21日)盤後公布財報。隨著公司加速擴建AI基礎設施，投資人期待看到新產品能否帶動營收，支撐長期成長並抵銷支出壓力。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) is the buzz around its new AI agent Muse cooling off? At least from the download data Wall Street is watching, there is no sign of that at all.
According to the latest data released by Sensor Tower, since Muse launched on September 8, it has amassed 10.9 million total downloads, with over 10.2 million of those coming from the United States.
By contrast, OpenAI’s ChatGPT saw its U.S. downloads over the past 30 days drop 25% compared with the preceding 30‑day period.
Sensor Tower estimates that Muse’s daily active users hit 2.5 million for the first time on October 16, and that the most recent seven‑day period grew 15% over the prior week.
Sensor Tower notes that only 11 other apps have ever reached 10 million U.S. downloads within 40 days, the most recent being Meta’s Threads, launched in July 2023.
This growth momentum is expected to please Wall Street. Since Muse’s debut, analysts on the street have been issuing upbeat forecasts for its outlook.

Deutsche Bank analyst Benjamin Black projects that by 2030 Muse will contribute as much as 8% of Meta’s revenue, roughly $36 billion; even a more conservative estimate still puts Muse’s 2030 revenue at $2.4 billion.

Black says Meta has identified a clear market gap in the current AI‑agent space; the product blends a mobile‑app ecosystem with an ultra‑smooth consumer interface, can execute transactions autonomously, offers most features for free, and runs 24/7 in a dedicated virtual machine, making it virtually unique in today’s market.

Meta is scheduled to release its earnings after the market closes on Wednesday (the 21st). As the company accelerates the build‑out of AI infrastructure, investors are eager to see whether the new product can drive revenue, support long‑term growth, and offset spending pressures.

items.title: 晶片股高點還在後頭？分析師看好漲勢延續至2027年
items.title_en: Chip Stocks Still Have Higher Peaks Ahead? Analysts See Upside Continuing Through 2027
paras: 《Investing.com》報導，Truist週二(20日)在一份報告中指出，半導體產業的基本面與股價報酬高峰都還在前方。歷史數據顯示，晶片股通常會在基本面見頂後約一季才觸及高點。
分析師William Stein寫道，「半導體基本面正處於超級週期（SuperCycle），成長速度更快、持續時間也更長，甚至超越1998年至2001年的科技泡沫時期。」
市場共識預估，2026年第四季半導體營收將年增74%。Stein指出，該季將是營收連續第15季改善，也可能成為這波週期的高峰。
他補充，相較之下，半導體需求通常在第7季、成長率達29%時見頂。科技泡沫時期的成長率高峰則為50%，而該輪週期在第14季時就已經崩跌。
Stein認為，這波週期強勁的主要原因是資料中心與AI需求。他也指出，由於不同產業的復甦時程並不同步，工業需求較晚才回升，進一步延長了這波週期的持續時間。
與一般認為股市會領先基本面約兩季的看法相反，Truist的研究發現，半導體股平均會在營收成長見頂後一季才觸及高點。
Stein表示，「這意味著半導體股至少到2027年第一季都應能持續帶來正報酬，至於行情能延續多久，則取決於未來幾季基本面成長是否進一步加速。若出現這種情況，我們並不意外。」
這位分析師也提到，費城半導體指數曾在6月22日至7月29日期間回檔29%。他指出，如此幅度的跌勢若未進一步演變成下行週期，歷史上相當罕見。
Stein寫道，「對我們而言，這意味著只要基本面維持穩健，股價進一步下跌的空間就有限。我們認為，即將公布的財報很可能成為多數我們追蹤公司的股價穩定催化劑。」
Truist重申對受惠於AI需求的輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)、超微(AMD-US)、博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)、Monolithic Power Systems(MPWR-US)及TTM Technologies(TTMI-US)給予「買進」評級。
此外，Truist也看好商業模式被形容為較脆弱、但仍獲「買進」評級的公司，包括Vishay、Arrow Electronics、Avnet、Diodes及Sensata。
paras_en: Investing.com reported that Truist on Tuesday (the 20th) said in a note that both the fundamentals of the semiconductor industry and the peak of stock returns are still ahead. Historical data shows chip stocks typically hit their highs about a quarter after fundamentals top out.
Analyst William Stein wrote, “Semiconductor fundamentals are in a super‑cycle, growing faster and lasting longer, even surpassing the tech bubble period of 1998‑2001.”

The market consensus forecasts semiconductor revenue to grow 74% year‑over‑year in Q4 2026. Stein noted that quarter would mark the 15th consecutive quarter of revenue improvement and could be the peak of this cycle.

He added that, by comparison, semiconductor demand usually peaks in the 7th quarter of a cycle at a 29% growth rate. The tech‑bubble era’s growth‑rate peak was 50%, and that cycle collapsed already in its 14th quarter.

Stein believes the strength of this cycle is driven mainly by data‑center and AI demand. He also pointed out that because recovery timelines differ across industries, industrial demand rebounds later, further extending the duration of this cycle.

Contrary to the common view that the stock market leads fundamentals by about two quarters, Truist’s research finds semiconductor stocks on average reach their price peaks one quarter after revenue growth tops out.

Stein said, “This means semiconductor stocks should continue delivering positive returns at least through Q1 2027; how long the rally lasts will depend on whether fundamental growth accelerates in the coming quarters. If that happens, we wouldn’t be surprised.”
The analyst also noted that the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 29% between June 22 and July 29. He said such a decline, if it does not turn into a down‑cycle, is historically rare.

Stein wrote, “For us, this means that as long as fundamentals stay solid, there is limited room for further price declines. We think the upcoming earnings reports are likely to act as a catalyst for price stability in most of the companies we follow.”
Truist reaffirmed “Buy” ratings on AI‑benefiting companies Nvidia (NVDA‑US), AMD (AMD‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US), Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR‑US) and TTM Technologies (TTMI‑US).
In addition, Truist is bullish on companies described as having more fragile business models but still receiving “Buy” ratings, including Vishay, Arrow Electronics, Avnet, Diodes and Sensata.

items.title: 〈財報〉AI業務成最大金雞母！SpaceX營收暴增161% 馬斯克證實討論與特斯拉合併
paras: 拜人工智慧(AI)業務大幅成長之賜，全球首富馬斯克的SpaceX(SPCX-US)第3季營收狂飆161%，與獲利一同交出優於市場預期的表現，最新發布的2027年度第1季財測也輕鬆超越市場預期，周二(20日)盤後應聲上漲近5%。
馬斯克在財報電話會議上表示，已成立特殊委員會開始討論SpaceX與特斯拉(TSLA-US)合併事宜，合併「將是個好主意」。特斯拉周二盤後應聲攀高1%，該公司緊接著將在周三盤後公布財報。

馬斯克(Elon Musk)旗下涵蓋衛星、火箭與AI業務的SpaceX在財報新聞稿中表示，第3季營業利益為28億美元，淨利達44億美元，而去年同期則是淨虧損10.5億美元。
SpaceX財務長Bret Johnsen在財報電話會議上預估，明年第1季營收將達330億至370億美元，他把亮麗展望歸功於「對未來六個月運算服務合約的商機掌握度提高」。
馬斯克在與投資人舉行的電話會議上表示：「SpaceX在火箭發射、連網服務與超級智慧(SI)這三大領域，正處於一個轉折時刻。」
SpaceX周二盤後上漲4.7%。該公司股價自6月以每股135美元完成創紀錄的首次公開發行(IPO)以來就陷入波動劇烈，周二正規交易時段收在每股147.79美元，目前市值2兆美元。

AI業務轉虧為盈 第3季營收年增逾八倍

SpaceX的AI業務目前更名為「超級智慧」(Super Intelligence，SI)，第3季營收從去年同期的8.13億美元躍升至75.6億美元，是去年同期的九倍以上，主要來自出租運算能力。
不過，AI業務也占公司196億美元資本支出中的164億美元，SpaceX預期近期資本支出將維持在接近這一水準。
SpaceX目前的AI收入主要來自向Anthropic、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google及Reflection AI等業者出租資料中心運算能力。該公司還在8月收購開發熱門AI程式碼工具的Cursor，而xAI開發的大型語言模型Grok採用率有所提升。

星鏈連網業務持續擴張 訂戶增至1,360萬人

SpaceX以可重複使用火箭聞名，但最近幾季公司的大部分營收與獲利主要來自連網業務部門，包括星鏈(Starlink)衛星網路服務。
星鏈第3季訂戶數增至1,360萬戶，高於前一季的1,200萬戶，高於分析師所估的1,219萬戶。
儘管用戶數不如預期，SpaceX的連網業務表現仍超越市場所料，第3季營收為52.5億美元，年增69%。其中，消費者Starlink訂戶占31.2億美元營收，政府及企業客戶則占21.3億美元。
由於SpaceX本月稍早宣布收購低頻頻譜，加上美國聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)批准該公司部署由1.5萬顆衛星組成的衛星星系計畫，市場對Starlink建立美國行動通訊網路的關注持續升溫。

星艦火箭發射業務成長有限 獲利仍靠星鏈撐

相較之下，SpaceX的太空發射業務僅小幅成長，第3季營收從去年同期的16.7億美元增至17.7億美元。
目前SpaceX幾乎所有獲利仍來自星鏈。連網業務部門營業利益幾乎翻倍至23.7億美元，AI業務則轉虧為盈，營業利益為4.31億美元。太空部門則出現700萬美元營業虧損。
SpaceX下一代可重複使用火箭系統「星艦」(Starship)尚未投入商業營運。這套系統預期將協助部署傳輸頻寬更高的星鏈衛星，以及軌道AI運算基礎設施。能否將星艦發展為可靠且可重複使用的運載工具，是SpaceX長期策略的關鍵。

items.title: 經濟學家警告：AI泡沫可能從投資人未關注的地方破裂
items.title_en: Economists Warn: AI Bubble Could Burst From Overlooked Areas
paras: AI泡沫疑慮升溫之際，一名經濟學家警告，投資人可能忽略了這波熱潮中的其他弱點。
Global Data.TS Lombard全球總體經濟董事總經理波金斯(Dario Perkins)在19日的報告中寫道：「引爆點不一定來自這波熱潮內部，也可能來自外部。」
他強調，目前 AI 產業的大部分營收成長，依然停留在生態系內部的資金循環，而非源自企業與消費者對 AI 服務的實質買單；關鍵在於這些收入究竟是來自產業外部，為了提升生產力而支付的費用，抑或僅是資本支出在體系內的重複轉手。
這項警告發布之際，恰逢近期晶片股遭到拋售，加深了市場對巨額 AI 基礎建設投資能否回收的擔憂。費城半導體指數繼先前重挫逾 11% 後，僅微幅回升 2%。
科技巨頭之外的債務隱憂
波金斯特別點出 AI 產業鏈中的脆弱環節，首先是科技巨頭之外的債務風險。
微軟、亞馬遜與Google等超大規模雲端業者的資產負債表雖然穩健，規模較小的雲端服務商、模型開發商與基礎建設供應商，卻持續提高財務槓桿。
波金斯估計，AI生態系部分領域的債務規模，到2027年底可能達到2兆美元。
他不認為AI相關債務構成系統性金融風險，但警告，獲利不如預期與訂單取消，可能在整個生態系引發連鎖效應。即使是現金充裕的超大規模雲端業者，也可能決定不再續租資料中心，讓財務較脆弱的公司承受風險。
晶片供過於求、利率走高恐衝擊投資
另一個潛在威脅則是晶片出現意料之外的過剩。由於企業先前為防止短缺而過度下單，一旦需求放緩，極可能造成供過於求。半導體與科技硬體屬高度週期性產業，極易受到「長鞭效應」影響。
此外，高利率環境也將進一步削弱 AI 投資的經濟效益，對仰賴舉債擴展業務的公司影響尤甚。
民意反彈也可能成為引爆點
除了企業獲利之外，波金斯認為另一個重大威脅來自政治層面的反彈。
他直言社交媒體上的 AI 擁護者猶如活在同溫層中，忽略了普通大眾對 AI 的反感。「他們沒有意識到，一般人並不喜歡AI。他們不覺得AI有用，更非常不願意住在資料中心附近，也擔心自己的工作。而且，他們會投票。」
他強調，只要發生一起引人關注的重大意外，就可能在短時間內讓 AI 形象徹底黑化，觸發大規模的社會與政治反彈。
paras_en: As concerns about an AI bubble heat up, an economist warns that investors may be overlooking other weak spots in this frenzy.

Dario Perkins, Managing Director of Global Data.TS Lombard’s Global Macro team, wrote in his report on the 19th: “The trigger point may not come from within the hype itself, but could arise from outside it.”

He stresses that most of the current AI industry’s revenue growth remains confined to internal capital circulation within the ecosystem, rather than stemming from genuine purchases of AI services by businesses and consumers; the key question is whether this income comes from outside the industry as a productivity‑enhancing expense, or merely represents repeated capital spending within the system.

The warning comes as chip stocks have recently been sold off, deepening market worries about whether massive AI infrastructure investments can be recouped. After the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell more than 11% earlier, it has only barely rebounded by 2%.
Debt risks beyond the tech giants
Perkins points out a fragile link in the AI supply chain: debt risk outside the major tech giants.

While the balance sheets of ultra‑large cloud providers such as Microsoft, Amazon and Google are solid, smaller cloud service firms, model developers and infrastructure suppliers are continuously increasing financial leverage.
Perkins estimates that debt in certain parts of the AI ecosystem could reach $2 trillion by the end of 2027.

He does not see AI‑related debt as a systemic financial risk, but warns that weaker‑than‑expected profits and order cancellations could trigger a chain reaction across the ecosystem. Even cash‑rich mega‑cloud providers might decide not to renew data‑center leases, leaving financially vulnerable companies exposed.
Chip oversupply and rising rates could hit investment

Another potential threat is an unexpected surplus of chips. Companies previously over‑ordered to avoid shortages; if demand eases, a supply glut could emerge. Semiconductors and tech hardware are highly cyclical industries, easily affected by a “bullwhip effect.”
Moreover, a high‑interest‑rate environment will further erode the economic returns of AI investments, hitting firms that rely on borrowing to expand especially hard.
Public backlash could also be a spark
Beyond corporate profits, Perkins sees a major threat from political backlash.

He bluntly says AI supporters on social media live in an echo chamber, ignoring ordinary people’s aversion to AI. “They don’t realize that most people don’t like AI. They don’t find it useful, they strongly dislike living near data centers, they fear for their jobs, and they will vote.”
He stresses that a single high‑profile incident could quickly tarnish AI’s image, triggering a massive social and political backlash.

items.title: 延宕多年終獲准！波音737 Max 10通過FAA認證 未來數月啟動交付
items.title_en: Delayed for Years, Finally Approved! Boeing 737 Max 10 Gains FAA Certification, Deliveries to Begin in Coming Months
paras: 多家外媒報導，波音 (BA-US) 旗下 737 Max 系列最大機型 737 Max 10，週二 (20 日) 正式取得美國聯邦航空總署 (FAA) 認證，為延宕多年的交機計畫掃除關鍵障礙。波音表示，預計未來數月開始交付，目前已取得來自 30 家客戶、共 1,555 架訂單。
737 Max 10 最多可搭載 230 名乘客，也是 737 Max 家族最後取得 FAA 認證的機型。波音指出，該機型約占整體 Max 未交付訂單的 30%，客戶包括阿拉斯加航空 (ALK-US)、美國航空 (AAL-US)、聯合航空 (UAL-US) 與達美航空 (DAL-US)。
取得認證後，波音得以推進交機作業，但航空公司仍需完成相關營運準備，將新機納入正式航班時刻表可能還要數月。
波音商用飛機部門執行長 Stephanie Pope 表示，完成認證計畫，為公司交付這款飛機鋪平道路。
737 Max 10 原定於 2020 年投入營運，但 2018 年及 2019 年接連發生的兩起 Max 空難，使監管機關加強審查，加上其他安全問題與工程設計變更，導致認證進度一再延後。其中，波音也必須調整發動機防結冰系統。
認證程序本月稍早又因一項可能影響降落程序的軟體問題而延宕。
不過，聯邦官員審查後認定，這項導航系統異常不構成飛航安全問題，最終批准認證。
多年延宕，也讓部分航空公司原先的客艙規畫面臨調整。
聯合航空執行長 Scott Kirby 今年 8 月曾表示，公司多年前為 Max 10 訂購的平躺座椅仍放在倉庫，如今已不再符合需求。阿拉斯加航空則於上月宣布，計畫在部分 737 Max 10 配置平躺座椅，擴大高階客艙服務。
隨著 Max 10 終於獲准，美國飛機認證流程的效率也成為焦點。美國運輸部長Sean Duffy 接受訪問時表示，安全仍是首要考量，但美國需要改善認證流程，以維持航空產業競爭力。
Duffy指出，波音飛機在歐洲完成認證所需的時間，約為美國的一半，甚至不到一半。
他還提及中國正積極爭取航空產業主導地位，強調美國若要保持競爭力，就必須加快飛機認證速度。
這次核准也為波音推進營運復甦增添助力。FAA 已於今年 8 月初批准 Max 系列最小機型 Max 7，波音則持續提高 737 Max 與 787 夢幻客機產量，並於 7 月在華盛頓州艾弗雷特啟用第 4 條 737 Max 生產線。
由於航空公司及其他客戶通常在交機時支付大部分購機款，提高產量並完成交付，是波音改善現金流的關鍵。
儘管認證取得重大進展，波音 (BA-US) 週二盤後股價微升 0.34%。分析指出，市場先前已普遍預期 Max 10 將獲批准，可能是股價反應有限的原因。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media reported that Boeing's (BA-US) largest 737 Max variant, the 737 Max 10, officially received certification from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on Tuesday (the 20th), clearing a key hurdle for a delivery program that has been delayed for years. Boeing said deliveries are expected to start in the next few months and it already has orders for 1,555 aircraft from 30 customers.

The 737 Max 10 can seat up to 230 passengers and is the last model in the Max family to obtain FAA certification. Boeing noted that the type represents about 30% of the total undelivered Max order backlog, with customers including Alaska Airlines (ALK-US), American Airlines (AAL-US), United Airlines (UAL-US) and Delta Air Lines (DAL-US).

With certification secured, Boeing can move forward with deliveries, but airlines still need to complete operational preparations, and it may take several months before the new jets are placed into regular flight schedules.
Boeing Commercial Airplanes CEO Stephanie Pope said that completing the certification program paves the way for the company to deliver the aircraft.

The Max 10 was originally slated to enter service in 2020, but two fatal Max crashes in 2018 and 2019 prompted regulators to tighten scrutiny. Additional safety issues and engineering design changes, including adjustments to the engine anti‑icing system, repeatedly pushed back the certification timeline.
The certification process was further delayed earlier this month by a software issue that could affect the landing procedure.
However, after review, federal officials determined the navigation‑system anomaly did not constitute a flight‑safety issue and ultimately approved the certification.
The years‑long delay has forced some airlines to revise their original cabin‑layout plans.

United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby said in August that the lie‑flat seats United ordered for the Max 10 years ago are still in storage and no longer meet the airline’s needs. Alaska Airlines announced last month that it plans to equip some Max 10s with lie‑flat seats to expand premium cabin service.

With the Max 10 finally cleared, the efficiency of the U.S. aircraft certification process has come under scrutiny. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said safety remains the top priority, but the United States needs to improve the certification process to keep the aviation industry competitive.
Duffy noted that the time required for Boeing aircraft to receive certification in Europe is roughly half, or even less than half, of the time needed in the United States.
He also mentioned that China is actively seeking a leading role in the aviation sector and stressed that the U.S. must speed up aircraft certification if it wants to stay competitive.

The approval also adds momentum to Boeing’s effort to revive operations. The FAA approved the smallest Max variant, the Max 7, in early August, Boeing continues to ramp up production of the 737 Max and 787 Dreamliner, and opened a fourth 737 Max production line in Everett, Washington, in July.
Because airlines and other customers typically pay most of the purchase price at delivery, increasing production and completing deliveries is key for Boeing to improve its cash flow.

Despite the significant certification milestone, Boeing’s (BA-US) after‑hours stock price rose only 0.34% on Tuesday. Analysts said the market had already largely expected Max 10 approval, which may explain the modest price reaction.

items.title: 傳陸企下訂逾350億美元晶片大單 輝達股價仍難振作
items.title_en: Chinese firms place over $35 billion chip order, Nvidia stock still struggles
paras: 即使傳出中國科技巨頭向輝達 (NVDA-US) 下單逾350億美元，輝達股價仍未明顯走高。龐大需求雖凸顯中國業者對其產品的依賴，但產能不足讓訂單能否轉化為營收存在變數，市場對人工智慧 (AI) 支出與融資負擔的疑慮也尚未消退。
輝達週二 (20日) 收低0.29%，報每股216.47美元，雖已收斂稍早約2%的跌幅，表現仍落後同業。同一時間，英特爾 (INTC-US) 與超微 (AMD-US) 分別下滑約0.37%及0.62%，費城半導體指數收黑約0.3%。
輝達晶片採購消息來自《路透》報導。知情人士透露，阿里巴巴 (BABA-US)、騰訊 (00700-HK) 與字節跳動，合計訂購超過300萬張輝達 RTX PRO 5500 顯卡，按每張約11,400美元的標價計算，潛在總值超過350億美元。
RTX PRO 5500 是專業工作站顯卡，效能不及輝達更先進的資料中心處理器。
不過，在美國出口管制限制中國取得高階晶片的情況下，這款產品成為替代選項，中國業者主要希望將其用於 AI 推論，也就是執行已完成訓練的模型。
然而，客戶下單不代表輝達能全數交貨。
《路透》消息人士指出，輝達已告知客戶與合作夥伴，由於需求遠超過原定生產規模，無法保證滿足全部訂單，部分合作夥伴可能只能取得原訂購量的5%至10%。
消息人士另稱，中國客戶對 RTX PRO 5500 的總訂購量已超過600萬張，但輝達2027年全球產量可能不超過300萬張。
上述數字屬於消息人士透露的訂單估計與生產規畫，並非公司正式公布的指引。
產能分配也限制輝達擴大供貨的空間。
隨著下一代 Rubin 平台成為製造重點，輝達須在不同產品之間配置資源，進一步增加 RTX PRO 5500 訂單的交付變數。
《Stocks Down Under》因此分析，需求與供應之間的落差，有助於解釋市場為何未對這筆大單更為振奮。
此外，這項消息傳出之際，AI 類股正承受投資情緒轉弱的壓力。
市場擔憂，建置 AI 基礎設施所需的龐大資本支出與舉債，能否換得足以支撐估值的投資回報，讓單一訂單利多難以扭轉整體疑慮。
截至週一，輝達過去2週累計下跌逾10%。即使週一反彈1.4%，股價仍低於50日移動平均線。對投資人而言，後續關鍵在於實際交貨規模，以及這些訂單能為輝達帶來多少營收與獲利。
paras_en: Even though reports say a Chinese tech giant placed an order of more than $35 billion with Nvidia (NVDA-US), the stock has not risen noticeably. The huge demand underscores Chinese firms' reliance on its products, but capacity constraints make it uncertain whether the orders will translate into revenue, and concerns about AI spending and financing burdens remain unresolved.

Nvidia closed Tuesday (the 20th) down 0.29% at $216.47 per share, having narrowed an earlier roughly 2% drop, but its performance still lagged peers. At the same time, Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US) fell about 0.37% and 0.62% respectively, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was down about 0.3%.

The news of Nvidia chip purchases came from a Reuters report. Sources said Alibaba (BABA-US), Tencent (00700-HK) and ByteDance together ordered more than 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards, priced at roughly $11,400 each, giving a potential total value of over $35 billion.
The RTX PRO 5500 is a professional workstation graphics card whose performance is below Nvidia's more advanced data‑center processors.

However, under U.S. export controls that limit China's access to high‑end chips, this product becomes a substitute option, with Chinese firms mainly hoping to use it for AI inference – running models that have already been trained.
Nevertheless, a customer order does not guarantee Nvidia can deliver the full quantity.

Reuters sources said Nvidia has told customers and partners that, because demand far exceeds its planned production capacity, it cannot guarantee fulfillment of all orders and some partners may only receive 5% to 10% of the originally requested amount.
The sources added that Chinese customers' total order for the RTX PRO 5500 has exceeded 6 million units, while Nvidia’s global output for 2027 may not exceed 3 million units.
These figures are estimates of orders and production plans disclosed by sources, not formal guidance from the company.
Capacity allocation also limits Nvidia’s ability to expand supply.
As the next‑generation Rubin platform becomes a manufacturing focus, Nvidia must allocate resources across different products, further increasing the uncertainty of delivering RTX PRO 5500 orders.
Stocks Down Under therefore analyses that the gap between demand and supply helps explain why the market has not reacted more positively to the large order.
Moreover, the news comes as AI‑related stocks are under pressure from weakening investor sentiment.

The market worries that the massive capital expenditures and debt required to build AI infrastructure may not generate sufficient returns to justify valuations, making a single order’s upside insufficient to offset broader concerns.

As of Monday, Nvidia had fallen more than 10% over the past two weeks. Even after a 1.4% rebound on Monday, the share price remained below its 50‑day moving average. For investors, the next key issues are the actual delivery scale and how much revenue and profit these orders will generate for Nvidia.

items.title: 〈財報〉Netflix Q3優預期盤後仍跌6% 廣告與營收展望拖累
items.title_en: <Earnings> Netflix Q3 Beats Expectations but Shares Fall 6% After Hours; Ad and Revenue Outlook Dragging
paras: 串流影音巨頭Netflix(NFLX-US)週二(20日)盤後公布第三季(截至9/30)財報，獲利優於分析師預期，營收則符合預估，但下修了全年廣告業務營收預測，也收窄2026全年財測區間，導致盤後股價下跌6%。
Netflix表示，受惠於會員數成長，以及3月生效的訂閱價格調漲，公司營收年增近12%。Netflix指出，消費者對此次漲價的反應，與過去調價的情況及公司預期一致。
第三季淨利為36.6億美元，或每股盈餘0.87美元；去年同期淨利為25.5億美元，或每股盈餘0.59美元。Netflix表示，獲利年增部分歸因於費用認列的時間差異。

Q3 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：128.7 億美元 v.s. 128.7 億美元
調整後EPS：0.87 美元 v.s. 0.82 美元


公司預期，第四季營收將年增逾11%，達134.4億美元，成長動能來自會員數增加、訂閱價格調整及廣告收入成長。
Netflix收窄2026年全年財測區間，目前預期全年營收將達511億美元，較前一年成長13%。這個數字落在公司前次財報所提供的510億至514億美元預測區間低端，也低於LSEG預估的全年營收512億美元。
華爾街與投資人密切關注Netflix在近期組織調整後，是否會進一步說明公司策略。Netflix目前面臨的挑戰包括觀看時數成長停滯，以及YouTube等競爭對手帶來的競爭壓力。
Netflix週二在致股東信中表示，「在競爭激烈、爭奪消費者注意力的內容大量湧現之際，清晰的策略方向與卓越的執行力至關重要。第三季，我們在三項優先工作上都取得良好成果，但我們認為，透過持續聚焦與不斷改善，仍有進一步提升的空間。」
Netflix上週宣布裁員約6%，相當於約1,000名員工。同時，內容長Bela Bajaria也將離開現任職位。
Netflix週二表示，預期第四季業績將受到裁員影響，營業利益率將因此減少約120個基點。
前迪士尼高層Peter Rice已獲任命為新任內容長，但他將如何處理觀看時數成長方面的疑慮，目前仍不明朗。
Netflix在致股東信中表示，「我們知道部分投資人對觀看時數的成長感到擔憂。」但公司強調，「涵蓋觀看數量、品質與多樣性的用戶參與度仍維持健康，且我們持續為會員提供強大的價值。」
公司希望加快觀看時數的成長，並計劃透過三大策略達成目標：為會員提供更多娛樂價值、運用科技改善服務的各個面向，以及提升營收變現能力。
Netflix提供的價值中，價格較低的廣告方案一直是重要的一環。然而，公司週二下修了全年廣告業務營收預測。
Netflix目前預期，2026年廣告營收約為27億美元，低於先前預估的約30億美元。公司表示，這次下修是因為部分廣告產品功能的推出進度慢於預期。
週二稍早，Netflix宣布推出多項廣告業者新功能，表示這些功能將協助品牌更精準地接觸目標受眾，並衡量廣告投放成效。
paras_en: Streaming giant Netflix (NFLX-US) posted its third‑quarter (ended Sep 30) results after market close on Tuesday the 20th. Profit topped analysts’ forecasts and revenue met estimates, but the company cut its full‑year ad‑business revenue outlook and narrowed its 2026 full‑year financial guidance range, sending the stock down 6% after hours.

Netflix said that growth in subscriber numbers and a subscription price increase that took effect in March helped revenue rise nearly 12% year over year. The company noted that consumer reaction to the price hike was in line with past adjustments and its own expectations.

Third‑quarter net income was $3.66 billion, or earnings per share of $0.87; a year earlier net income was $2.55 billion, or $0.59 per share. Netflix attributed the year‑over‑year profit increase in part to timing differences in expense recognition.

Q3 key figures versus LSEG estimates: Revenue $12.87 billion vs. $12.87 billion; Adjusted EPS $0.87 vs. $0.82. The company projects fourth‑quarter revenue to grow more than 11% year over year to $13.44 billion, driven by higher subscriber counts, subscription price adjustments and ad‑revenue growth.

Netflix narrowed its 2026 full‑year financial guidance, now expecting total revenue of $51.1 billion, up 13% from the prior year. This figure sits at the low end of the company’s previous $51.0‑$51.4 billion range and below LSEG’s $51.2 billion revenue estimate.

Wall Street and investors are watching closely to see whether Netflix will further clarify its strategy after recent organizational changes. Challenges facing the company include stalled growth in viewing hours and competitive pressure from rivals such as YouTube.

In a letter to shareholders on Tuesday, Netflix said, “In an environment of intense competition and a flood of content vying for consumer attention, clear strategic direction and excellent execution are critical. In Q3 we delivered solid results on all three priority areas, but we believe there is still room for improvement through continued focus and relentless refinement.”
Netflix announced last week a roughly 6% workforce reduction, about 1,000 jobs, and content chief Bela Bajaria will be departing her current role.
The company said on Tuesday that fourth‑quarter performance would be affected by the layoffs, with operating margin expected to shrink by roughly 120 basis points.
Former Disney executive Peter Rice has been appointed as the new head of content, but how he will address concerns about viewing‑hour growth remains unclear.

In its shareholder letter, Netflix acknowledged, “We know some investors are concerned about the growth of viewing hours.” The company emphasized that overall user engagement—covering volume, quality and variety of viewing—remains healthy and that it continues to deliver strong value to members.

Netflix aims to accelerate viewing‑hour growth and plans to do so through three main strategies: delivering more entertainment value to members, leveraging technology to improve all aspects of the service, and enhancing revenue‑monetization capabilities.
Ad‑supported, lower‑priced subscription tiers have long been a key part of Netflix’s value proposition. However, the company cut its full‑year ad‑business revenue forecast on Tuesday.
Netflix now expects 2026 ad revenue to be about $2.7 billion, down from the prior estimate of roughly $3.0 billion, citing slower‑than‑expected rollout of certain ad‑product features.
Earlier on Tuesday, Netflix announced a suite of new ad‑seller features, saying they will help brands reach target audiences more precisely and measure the effectiveness of their ad spend.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走低 伊朗局勢與AI風險牽動市場
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Slides as Iran Tensions and AI Risks Stir Markets
paras: 美元周二(20日)走低，與油價及較長天期美國公債殖利率下跌走勢一致。交易員正評估美國與伊朗戰事緊張情勢升高的影響，以及資金持續大舉流入美國AI企業的趨勢能否延續。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.25%，報101.71。
油價在觸及五個月高點後回落。交易員一方面關注伊朗總統與巴基斯坦陸軍參謀長的會面，後者是美伊談判的重要斡旋者。另一方面，也評估葉門青年運動（ Houthi）持續攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯基礎設施，以及波斯灣海域傳出船隻遭襲的消息。
油價上漲加深了市場對通膨可能在更長時間內維持高檔的憂慮。上週，美國公布的數據顯示，9月消費者物價通膨加速，帶動美元走強。
然而，市場焦點很快又轉向AI相關疑慮。
野村證券G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning表示，「能源價格上漲有利美元，但如果利率因此升得太高，甚至導致AI交易行情崩盤，情況就會突然轉為不利因素。我們面臨一道臨界點，而目前市場正處於這個臨界點附近。」
大量資金流入美國AI股票，一直為美元提供支撐。部分與AI產業相關的成長及通膨預期推升利率，也進一步支撐美元。
不過，週二稍早，市場對AI的疑慮再度升溫。南韓AI服務公司Elice Group在首爾股市掛牌首日，股價暴跌32%。
歐元兌美元上漲0.22%，至1.1235美元。
儘管歐元週二上漲，交易員仍對其前景保持謹慎，因為法國正面臨大規模抗議活動，財政狀況也持續惡化。
法國政府週二表示，將增派軍警支援，並為週六預計舉行的新一輪抗議活動部署大規模維安措施。政府同時承認，在應對上週末的暴力事件時處置失當。
瑞典商業銀行（Handelsbanken）外匯策略師Tommy von Brömsen表示，「法國面臨的憂慮短期內不會消退。市場對法國的看空情緒還會持續一段時間，歐元也仍有進一步走弱的空間。」
英鎊兌美元上漲0.59%，至1.338美元。
英國最新公布的勞動市場數據顯示，就業市場仍具韌性，這也是近期一系列優於預期的英國經濟數據之一。
eToro全球市場策略師Lale Akoner表示，「風險在於，強韌的勞動市場可能讓英格蘭銀行(BoE)既有空間、也有理由再次升息。升息預期升高，可能有利英鎊。」
根據LSEG數據，市場幾乎已完全反映英格蘭銀行將在11月5日的下次會議升息1碼。
日本長天期公債(JGBs)標售吸引創紀錄的需求，帶動日元走強。
道富投資管理公司資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo表示，「20年期公債標售創下紀錄，強烈顯示先前觀望的資金終於開始回流。日本公債也逐漸成為相對安全的避風港，可用來因應歐洲政治與財政局勢的波動，尤其是法國的相關風險。」
日元兌美元上漲0.21%，至158.14日元。
其他貨幣方面，加拿大亞伯達省居民在該省首次舉行的分離公投中，多數支持繼續留在加拿大。消息公布後，加幣兌美元上漲0.34%，至1.406加幣，升至近一個月來最強。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Tuesday (the 20th), moving in line with declining oil prices and longer‑term U.S. Treasury yields. Traders are weighing the impact of heightened U.S.–Iran conflict risk and whether the massive inflow of capital into U.S. AI firms can continue.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.25% to 101.71.

Oil prices retreated after hitting a five‑month high. Traders are watching a meeting between Iran’s president and the Pakistani army chief, a key mediator in U.S.–Iran talks, while also assessing the Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and reports of a vessel being struck in the Persian Gulf.

Higher oil prices have deepened market worries that inflation could stay elevated for a longer period. Last week, U.S. data showed September consumer‑price inflation accelerating, which had previously boosted the dollar.
However, market focus quickly shifted back to AI‑related concerns.

Dominic Bunning, head of G10 FX strategy at Nomura Securities, said, “Rising energy prices are supportive of the dollar, but if rates climb too high and even trigger a collapse in AI trading activity, the situation could flip to a negative factor. We are at a critical juncture, and the market is currently hovering near that point.”
Large inflows into U.S. AI stocks have been underpinning the dollar. Some growth and inflation expectations tied to the AI sector have pushed rates higher, further supporting the greenback.
Nevertheless, early on Tuesday, doubts about AI resurfaced. South Korean AI services firm Elice Group saw its shares plunge 32% on the first day of trading on the Seoul exchange.
The euro rose 0.22% against the dollar to $1.1235.
Even though the euro gained on Tuesday, traders remain cautious about its outlook as France faces massive protests and a deteriorating fiscal situation.

The French government said on Tuesday it will deploy additional military police and implement extensive security measures ahead of a new round of protests expected on Saturday, while also acknowledging mishandling of last weekend’s violent incidents.

Tommy von Brömsen, FX strategist at Sweden’s Handelsbanken, said, “The concerns facing France will not dissipate in the short term. Bearish sentiment on France is likely to persist for a while, leaving room for the euro to weaken further.”
The pound rose 0.59% against the dollar to $1.338.
The latest UK labour market data show the employment market remains resilient, adding to a series of recent UK economic releases that have outperformed expectations.

Lale Akoner, global markets strategist at eToro, said, “The risk is that a robust labour market could give the Bank of England both the space and the incentive to raise rates again. Higher rate‑rise expectations could be bullish for the pound.”
LSEG data indicate the market has almost fully priced in a one‑basis‑point rate hike by the Bank of England at its next meeting on November 5.
Japan’s long‑term government bond (JGB) auction attracted record demand, strengthening the yen.

Masahiko Loo, senior fixed‑income strategist at State Street Global Advisors, said, “The record‑setting 20‑year bond auction shows that previously cautious capital is finally flowing back. Japanese bonds are increasingly seen as a relatively safe haven to hedge against volatility in European political and fiscal developments, especially the risks linked to France.”
The yen rose 0.21% against the dollar to ¥158.14.

In other currencies, residents of Alberta, Canada, voted in the province’s first separatist referendum, with a majority supporting staying in Canada. After the result was announced, the Canadian dollar rose 0.34% to C$1.406, its strongest level in nearly a month.

items.title: 〈台幣〉外資提款台股並匯出一度重貶2.27角 失守32.6元關卡
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Pull Out, Taiwan Stocks and Currency Both Plunge; TWD Briefly Drops 0.227 NTD, Losing the 32.6‑NTD Barrier
paras: 股匯雙殺再現，三大法人今(20)日合計賣超台股968.04億元，外資及陸資賣超795.4億元，台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元終場收在32.617元，重貶1.72角，成交金額達32.77億美元；元太外匯市場成交金額為9.995億美元。兩大外匯市場今日成交金額合計高達 42.765 億美元，顯示在熱錢急退與避險結匯需求湧現下，匯市交投異常熱絡。
新台幣今日以32.48元開出，盤中最高32.48元，隨後受外資擴大匯出影響，一度衝破32.67元關卡，盤中下探至32.672元，最低重貶2.27角，全日維持弱勢重貶格局。
從國際盤與總體環境觀察，雖然美股科技族群昨日出現逢低買盤，帶動那斯達克與費城半導體指數反彈，但亞幣整體維持弱勢格局，直接加重了新台幣的走貶壓力。市場資金在區域資產間快速挪移，外資於台股及匯市同步進行提款操作，形成匯市盤中沉重的下行連動壓力。

paras: 美元周一(19日)走強，主要受到歐元下跌，以及美國債券市場再度出現拋售潮的推動。

法國陷入動盪
美國及全球外匯市場的參與者，正密切關注法國局勢不斷升級的情況。
作為歐元區第二大經濟體，法國週末爆發大規模暴力抗議，民眾不滿生活成本飆升，以及公共服務經費不足。同時，法國本身也正面臨財政危機。
法國各城市有數千人與警方發生衝突，部分商店遭到洗劫，造成近年來最嚴重社會動亂之一。暴力事件進一步加大法國總統馬克宏（Emmanuel Macron）政治壓力。在 2027 年任期結束前，他的施政已因日益高漲的社會不滿情緒而陷入愈發嚴重的停滯。
由於法國政府公債（OAT）表現落後，而透過信用違約交換（CDS）為法國主權債務投保的成本也升至多年高點，法國公債與德國聯邦公債（Bund）之間的利差進一步擴大，對歐元構成直接的基本面壓力。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.3%，至 1.1210 美元。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師 Thierry Wizman 表示，「法國的社會局勢可能帶來一種和平且具宣洩效果的改變，例如透過提高退休年齡來推動緊縮政策，前提是民主制度能夠維持穩定。然而，真正可能引發轉變的 2027 年大選，對大多數交易員而言仍太遙遠。他們更擔心的是未來幾週的局勢發展。」
他進一步指出，「只要電視畫面持續出現混亂景象，市場就傾向於賣出歐元，並推高法國主權債務利差。如果法國出現存款外流，將可能促使歐洲央行（ECB）介入，而這很可能進一步削弱歐元。」
法國 10 年期公債殖利率週一大幅上升，債券拋售壓力也蔓延至美國市場。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 4.5 個基點，來到 5.145%。對利率政策較為敏感的 2 年期公債殖利率則上升 4 個基點，來到 4.776%。
日元走弱 加幣走強
日元走弱，美元兌日元升至 158.53。

植田的發言進一步強化市場預期：央行仍將循序漸進地推動貨幣政策正常化。因此，利率市場持續關注日銀今年稍晚可能採取的貨幣政策調整。

這項提議引發印尼雅加達綜合指數單日暴跌 11.6%，創下 1998 年亞洲金融風暴以來最大單日跌幅。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Monday (the 19th), mainly driven by a falling euro and a renewed wave of selling in the U.S. bond market.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 102. Earlier, the index had posted its first weekly decline in nearly five weeks, as expectations for near‑term Fed rate hikes cooled slightly.
France in Turmoil
Market participants in the U.S. and global FX markets are watching the escalating situation in France closely.

As the euro‑area’s second‑largest economy, France saw massive violent protests over the weekend, with citizens angry about soaring living costs and underfunded public services, while the country also faces a fiscal crisis.

Thousands clashed with police in cities across France, some shops were looted, creating one of the most severe social upheavals in recent years. The violence adds political pressure on President Emmanuel Macron, whose agenda is increasingly stalled by rising social discontent ahead of the end of his term in 2027.

Because French government bonds (OAT) have underperformed and the cost of insuring French sovereign debt via credit‑default swaps (CDS) has risen to multi‑year highs, the spread between French OATs and German Bunds has widened, putting direct fundamental pressure on the euro.
The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1210.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “France’s social situation could lead to a peaceful, venting‑type change, such as raising the retirement age to push a tightening agenda, provided the democratic system remains stable. However, the real catalyst – the 2027 election – is still too far away for most traders. They are more concerned about how the situation develops over the next few weeks.”

He added, “As long as TV screens keep showing chaos, markets tend to sell euros and push French sovereign spreads higher. If France sees capital outflows, the European Central Bank may step in, which could further weaken the euro.”
French 10‑year bond yields jumped sharply on Monday, and bond‑selling pressure spread to the U.S. market.
U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields rose 4.5 basis points to 5.145%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield climbed 4 basis points to 4.776%.
Yen Weakens, Canadian Dollar Strengthens
The yen weakened as the dollar rose to ¥158.53.
Japanese authorities have previously signaled a joint warning with the United States, and the FX trading desk remains on high alert for possible intervention by Tokyo officials at current levels.
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said in a public remarks that Japan’s core inflation is steadily moving toward the central bank’s 2% target.
Ueda’s comments reinforced market expectations that the BOJ will continue a gradual normalization of monetary policy, keeping rate markets focused on potential policy adjustments later this year.
On the other hand, the Indonesian rupiah finally halted a four‑day losing streak. During the decline it had slipped to IDR 18,063 per dollar, a three‑month low.
The sell‑off was sparked by an MSCI proposal to downgrade Indonesia’s equity market rating, citing long‑standing difficulties for foreign investors and corporate‑governance concerns.
The proposal triggered an 11.6% single‑day plunge in the Jakarta Composite Index, the biggest daily drop since the 1998 Asian financial crisis.
In other markets, the Canadian dollar rose against the dollar, with USD/CAD slipping to 1.4110.
Canadian consumer inflation accelerated, raising expectations that the Bank of Canada may adopt a tighter policy stance.

It also marked the first time in three months that Canada’s CPI moved above the BoC’s 1%‑3% target range.
The CPI increase was mainly driven by energy prices, which rose 19% year‑over‑year, with gasoline jumping 27.8%.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢持續流出 重貶1.07角收32.445元
items.title_en: TWD: Hot Money Continues to Flow Out, Depreciates 0.107 to Close at 32.445
paras: 台北金融市場今(19) 日「股匯雙殺」再現，受到美股震盪及國際避險情緒升溫影響，外資持續大舉撤資，三大法人合計賣超台股899.54億元，加權指數一度重挫941點，台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 等權值股尾盤急拉，終場下跌289.18點，收在46822.08點。匯市在資金大量淨匯出壓力下，新台幣兌美元匯率開低走低，盤中一度觸及32.572元低點，終場重貶1.07角收在32.445元，兩大外匯市場爆出38.53億美元的大量。
觀察台股法人動態，三大法人今日資金操作分歧明顯。外資及陸資延續偏空態度，單日賣超高達767.43億元，寫下連續9個交易日賣超紀錄；自營商也站在賣方，賣超362.63億元；僅投信法人獨撐大局，逆勢買超230.51億元，展現強烈護盤意願。
今日台股籌碼面持續出現調節，導致大盤開盤即遭重挫，盤中最低下探46170點，考驗季線支撐，所幸尾盤台積電等半導體族群拉回平盤，帶動指數跌幅收斂。
匯市方面，新台幣兌美元開盤價為32.36元，隨後受外資強勁匯出買賣盤衝擊，匯價一路下探，早盤最高僅達32.36元，盤中最低重摔至32.572元。面對外資短時間大幅撤離，中央銀行盤中罕見緊急發布聲明穩固信心，並適時進場拋匯提供美元流動性。終場台北外匯市場新台幣收在32.445元，貶值1.07角；成交金額則擴大至28.31億美元。
元太外匯市場新台幣收盤價則為32.468元，貶值1.2角，成交金額為10.22億美元。兩大匯市合計成交金額衝高至38.53億美元，顯示市場交投極為熱絡且多空對峙激烈。
paras_en: Taipei's financial markets saw a repeat of the "stock‑currency double kill" today (19th) as US equity volatility and rising global risk‑off sentiment prompted foreign investors to pull out large amounts of capital. The three major institutional investors collectively sold a net 89.954 billion TWD of Taiwanese equities, and the weighted index plunged as much as 941 points before ending down 289.18 points at 46,822.08. Meanwhile, under heavy net outflows in the foreign exchange market, the New Taiwan dollar weakened against the US dollar, briefly hitting a low of 32.572 TWD per USD before closing down 0.107 to 32.445, with the two major FX markets reporting a combined outflow of $3.853 billion.

Looking at the activity of Taiwan's institutional investors, today's fund flows showed a clear divergence. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors maintained a bearish stance, net selling a record 76.743 billion TWD in a single day, marking the ninth consecutive trading day of net outflows. Proprietary traders also sold, netting 36.263 billion TWD. Only investment trusts stood on the buying side, net purchasing 23.051 billion TWD, demonstrating a strong willingness to support the market.

The market's capital structure continued to adjust today, causing the index to tumble sharply at the open and dip to a intraday low of 46,170 points, testing the seasonal (quarterly) support line. Fortunately, semiconductor stocks such as TSMC rallied in the closing minutes, pulling the index back toward the flat line and narrowing the overall decline.

In the FX market, the TWD opened at 32.36 per USD but was quickly pressured lower by strong foreign outflows, falling to a low of 32.572 during the session. Facing a rapid, large‑scale withdrawal of foreign capital, the central bank issued a rare emergency statement mid‑session to steady confidence and intervened by selling dollars to provide liquidity. The Taipei foreign‑exchange market closed the TWD at 32.445, a depreciation of 0.107, with transaction volume expanding to $2.831 billion.

The Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market closed the TWD at 32.468, a depreciation of 0.12, with a transaction volume of $1.022 billion. Combined, the two major FX markets saw total turnover rise to $3.853 billion, indicating extremely active trading and fierce battles between buyers and sellers.

items.title: 印尼股票市場拋售加劇 並蔓延至債券與印尼盾
items.title_en: Indonesia Stock Market Sell‑Off Intensifies and Spreads to Bonds and Rupiah
paras: 印尼雅加達綜合指數(JCI)持續下挫，周一(19日)盤中一度重挫5.4%，延續上周五崩跌12%的頹勢。此次下跌，主要受到指數編算公司摩根士丹利資本國際(MSCI Inc.)發出潛在降級警告影響。
相關衝擊造成印尼金融市場拋售潮全面擴大，股市陷入近30年來最嚴重暴跌，賣壓並迅速延燒至債券與印尼盾匯市。
MSCI 上周五表示，出於可投資性等疑慮，正考慮將印尼從「新興市場」直接降級至「獨立市場」，此舉遠超今年1月警示降至「邊境市場」的幅度。措手不及的印尼官方已安排於周一與 MSCI 高層會面尋求釐清。
高盛估算，若印尼被完全剔除，可能觸發約56億美元的被動型資金撤出，若富時羅素(FTSE Russell)跟進，恐再面臨27億美元流出風險。2026年截至目前，外資已從印尼股市淨撤出51億美元，創下歷史最大年度外流紀錄。
針對市場崩盤與資金外逃，新加坡東斯銀行(SEB)亞洲策略主管 Eugenia Victorino 指出：「外資正全線撤離印尼股市，債市也感受到熱度。印尼盾走弱正侵蝕實質殖利率，在匯率止穩前，全球資金寧可安全地位於場外觀望。」
PT MNC Sekuritas 分析師 Herditya Wicaksana 表示：「賣壓依然顯著，特別是像大型銀行這類對雅加達綜合指數影響巨大的股票。」
星展集團(DBS Group) 警告，衝擊可能進一步蔓延並緊縮融資條件，推升10年期國債殖利率邁向7.5%，並促使印尼央行再升息50至100個基點。
為遏止跌勢，印尼證券交易所周一緊急調緊單一股票每日最大跌幅限制，由15%縮減至7%，施行至今年底
。企業端也展開自救，富豪 Prajogo Pangestu 旗下三家公司計畫合計買回2.5兆印尼盾(約1.38億美元)庫藏股；金光集團旗下 PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa 也提議買回1兆印尼盾股票。
paras_en: Indonesia’s Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) kept sliding, plunging as much as 5.4% during Monday’s (the 19th) session, extending the 12% crash that began last Friday. The drop was mainly triggered by a potential downgrade warning issued by the index‑calculating firm MSCI Inc.

The fallout sparked a broad sell‑off across Indonesia’s financial markets, with the equity market experiencing its steepest plunge in nearly 30 years and selling pressure quickly spilling over into bonds and the rupiah foreign‑exchange market.

MSCI said on Friday that, due to concerns over investability, it is considering moving Indonesia from the “Emerging Markets” category directly to “Standalone Market,” a step far beyond the warning in January that it might be demoted to a “Frontier Market.” Caught off guard, Indonesian officials have arranged a meeting with senior MSCI officials on Monday to seek clarification.

Goldman Sachs estimates that a full removal of Indonesia could trigger about $5.6 billion of passive‑fund outflows, and if FTSE Russell follows suit, another $2.7 billion could flee. To date in 2026, foreign investors have net‑withdrawn $5.1 billion from Indonesia’s stock market, setting a record for the largest annual outflow.

Commenting on the market crash and capital flight, Eugenia Victorino, head of Asian strategy at Singapore’s SEB, said: “Foreign investors are pulling out of Indonesian equities across the board, and the bond market is feeling the heat. A weaker rupiah is eroding real yields, and until the currency stabilises, global capital would rather stay safely off‑exchange and wait.”
Herditya Wicaksana, an analyst at PT MNC Sekuritas, noted: “Selling pressure remains significant, especially in stocks like large banks that have a huge impact on the Jakarta Composite Index.”

DBS Group warned that the shock could spread further and tighten financing conditions, pushing the 10‑year government bond yield toward 7.5% and prompting the Bank of Indonesia to raise rates by another 50 to 100 basis points.

To curb the decline, the Indonesia Stock Exchange on Monday urgently tightened the daily maximum price‑move limit for individual stocks, cutting it from 15% to 7% effective through the end of the year.

Companies are also taking self‑help measures: billionaire Prajogo Pangestu’s three firms plan to repurchase a total of 2.5 trillion rupiah (about $138 million) of shares, and PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa of the Golden Light Group has proposed buying back 1 trillion rupiah of stock.

items.title: 人工智慧浪潮助推 馬來西亞9月出口額創逾5年新高
items.title_en: AI Wave Boosts Malaysia's September Export Value to Over Five-Year High
paras: 受惠於全球人工智慧(AI)浪潮與資料中心建置帶動的半導體及電子產品需求，馬來西亞今年9月外貿展現強勁成長力道，出口額刷新逾5年來最高紀錄。
根據馬來西亞統計局(DOSM)與投資貿易暨工業部(MITI)公布的最新數據，馬來西亞9月出口額達2,151億令吉(約合450億美元)，年增54.5%，表現遠超出《路透》調查預期的44.6%及《彭博》預估的39.9%。
在進出口同步雙位數成長帶動下，9月總貿易額年增53.7%至3,965億令吉。進口額則年增52.7%至1,814億令吉，高於市場預期的39%，9月貿易順差擴大約65%至337億令吉，高於預期的316億令吉。
統計局資料顯示，進口擴張主要由生產輸入端需求強勁所推升，其中中間財進口大增69.6%至921億令吉，資本財與消費財進口亦分別成長20.9%及18.2%。
從主要出口商品來看，占總出口半數以上的電子與電器產品(E&E)9月出口額年增率高達68%至69.2%，創下單月歷史新高。包含半導體測試儀器在內的光學與科學設備出口額亦同步登頂。
出口市場方面，對台灣出口年增率高達175.2%(成長超過一倍)，對美國出口成長89.9%，對中國出口則成長22.1%。相對地，受棕櫚油出口減少拖累，農業出口年減5.7%。
針對未來外貿展望，馬來西亞投資貿工部在官方聲明中特別警示：「馬來西亞的貿易表現仍面臨主要經濟體貿易政策轉變及地緣政治緊張局勢帶來的不確定性。」
MITI 分析，尤其是中東地區持續的衝突可能打亂全球貿易流動並加劇成本壓力。MITI 表示未來將持續「評估相關發展、加強市場多元化、擴大進入高成長市場，並協助馬來西亞出口商進行調整」，以增強外貿抗風險能力。
paras_en: Benefiting from the global artificial intelligence (AI) wave and the demand for semiconductors and electronic products driven by data‑center construction, Malaysia’s foreign trade showed strong growth in September, with export value reaching a record high not seen in more than five years.

According to the latest data released by Malaysia’s Department of Statistics (DOSM) and the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI), September export value hit RM215.1 billion (about US$45 billion), up 54.5% year‑on‑year, far exceeding Reuters’ forecast of 44.6% and Bloomberg’s estimate of 39.9%.

With both imports and exports posting double‑digit growth, total trade in September rose 53.7% year‑on‑year to RM396.5 billion. Imports increased 52.7% to RM181.4 billion, above the market’s 39% expectation, and the trade surplus widened about 65% to RM33.7 billion, higher than the anticipated RM31.6 billion.

Statistics show that the import expansion was mainly driven by strong demand for production inputs, with intermediate goods imports surging 69.6% to RM92.1 billion, while capital goods and consumer goods imports grew 20.9% and 18.2% respectively.

Looking at major export commodities, electronic and electrical (E&E) products, which account for more than half of total exports, posted a year‑on‑year growth of 68% to RM69.2 billion, setting a new monthly historical high. Exports of optical and scientific equipment, including semiconductor testing instruments, also hit record levels.

In terms of export markets, shipments to Taiwan jumped 175.2% year‑on‑year (more than double), to the United States grew 89.9%, and to China rose 22.1%. Conversely, agricultural exports fell 5.7% year‑on‑year due to a drop in palm‑oil shipments.

Regarding the outlook, MITI warned in an official statement that “Malaysia’s trade performance still faces uncertainty from major economies’ shifting trade policies and heightened geopolitical tensions.”

MITI analysis notes that ongoing conflicts in the Middle East could disrupt global trade flows and increase cost pressures. It said Malaysia will continue to “assess developments, strengthen market diversification, expand entry into high‑growth markets, and help exporters adjust,” to boost the resilience of its foreign trade.

paras_en: USD/JPY

Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell expressed optimism about the resilience of the U.S. economy and said that the investment boom spurred by artificial‑intelligence advances and its spill‑over into other sectors is creating short‑term demand pressure that could push inflation higher. He declined to reveal what actions might be taken at the remaining meetings this year, leaving the dollar under pressure. Meanwhile, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said it is becoming increasingly important to keep core‑inflation near the BOJ’s 2% target, and a Reuters poll shows that rising energy prices from the Middle‑East conflict are gradually passing through to households. Japan’s core CPI for September could exceed the BOJ’s 2% goal for the first time since December. U.S. Treasury Deputy Secretary Erin Browne added that Japan is no longer in a decade‑long deflationary environment, so its exchange‑rate level and monetary policy must adjust. Japanese investors have sold foreign bonds for the fourth consecutive week as of the week ending Oct. 10, continuing the pull‑out from overseas bond markets, which supports the yen and pushed USD/JPY down to a low of 157.67.

Subsequent U.S. official data for September showed industrial production up 0.7% and manufacturing output up 0.3%, while capacity utilization rose to 76.9%. Import and export prices rose 1.1% and 2.2% month‑over‑month, both above expectations, and import prices jumped 8.1% year‑over‑year – the biggest rise since July 2022. The figures indicate that, as the Middle‑East conflict persists, domestic inflation pressure in the United States is intensifying, driving the dollar up to a high of 158.33 against the yen. The market expects resistance for USD/JPY around 158.10‑30 and support around 157.30‑50.
EUR/USD

Weak Australian employment data led investors to downgrade bets on a fifth RBA rate hike this year, weighing on the Aussie dollar.
